name: fantasy dungeon
description: Explore the abandoned halls of an old fortress, from damp guard posts and hidden storerooms to a crypt sealed beneath the stone. Follow the traces left by earlier delvers, gather supplies and keys, and face the warden who still guards the inner vault.

items.name: Rusty Sword
items.description: A serviceable sword with a pitted blade.

items.name: Iron Sword
items.description: A plain but well-balanced dungeon sword.

items.name: Wooden Shield
items.description: A battered round shield reinforced with an iron rim.

items.name: Leather Cap
items.description: A close-fitting cap that offers modest protection.

items.name: Chain Shirt
items.description: A heavy shirt of linked iron rings.

items.name: Healing Potion
items.description: A small red flask that smells of herbs.

properties.use_message: Warmth spreads through you as the potion takes effect. (The expedition's standard recovery rules apply.)

items.name: Torch
items.description: A pitch-soaked torch suitable for the dark passages below.

properties.use_message: The torch flares brightly, revealing damp stone, old tracks, and dust in the air.

items.name: Iron Key
items.description: A cold iron key stamped with a simple three-towered mark.

items.name: Silver Key
items.description: A narrow silver key hidden among the old burial goods.

items.name: Coin Pouch
items.description: A leather pouch containing a modest cache of old coins.

items.name: Cut Gem
items.description: A cloudy but valuable red gem wrapped in faded cloth.

items.name: Locked Chest
items.description: A stout iron-banded chest. Its lock is intact and the lid is sealed.

items.name: Vault Casket
items.description: A small silver-bound casket recovered from the inner vault.

npcs.name: Wounded Scout
npcs.description: A weary explorer sheltering behind a stack of crates, with a bloodied bandage tied around one side.

nodes.body: The scout presses a hand to the bandage. 'The old guards still walk below. One carries an iron key with three towers stamped on it. And mind the floor stones near the guard post.'

responses.text: Thank you. I will watch my step.

npcs.name: Imprisoned Delver
npcs.description: A frightened delver waiting in a side cell, counting the footsteps beyond the door.

nodes.body: 'The crypt warden has the silver key. I heard it turn in the vault door before they shut me in. The outer gate lies past the deepest hall.'

responses.text: I will find the key and get you clear.

enemies.name: Cave Rat
enemies.description: A scarred rat with yellow teeth and a bold, hungry stare.

enemies.name: Restless Skeleton
enemies.description: A skeleton in scraps of burial cloth, clutching a corroded weapon.

enemies.name: Goblin Scavenger
enemies.description: A wiry goblin wearing mismatched scraps of armor and carrying stolen supplies.

enemies.name: Dungeon Guard
enemies.description: A former watchman in battered armor who still patrols the old holding levels.

enemies.name: Crypt Warden
enemies.description: The armored keeper of the deepest vault, roused from an ancient post.

descriptions.text: Worn steps descend from the surface to a landing beneath a three-towered crest. Empty torch brackets line the walls, and a draft carries the smell of wet earth from below.
A heavy gate stands beneath dusty banners bearing three towers. Beyond its bars, daylight reaches the old road out of the fortress.
Empty shelves ring a square vault. An iron-banded chest sits beneath a faded stone crest; fresh scuffs in the dust suggest someone has tried its lock recently.
A stone bier rises from the floor of a sunken crypt. Rusted weapons stand around it like a silent guard, while a silver-bound door waits beneath the far arch.
Rough-cut blocks form a narrow passage. Water beads on the walls and the dust holds several overlapping trails.
Iron brackets support guttering torches along a low corridor. Their smoke stains the ceiling black.
The passage slopes through packed earth and ancient masonry. Every footstep echoes farther than it should.
Splintered bunks and a bare weapon rack crowd this former barracks. Dice lie where a game was abandoned, and boot prints cross the dust toward the lower halls.
Crates and clay jars crowd this storeroom. Most are empty, but a few have survived behind a curtain of cobwebs.
Rows of burial niches recede into darkness. Most seals bear names worn smooth by time; one has been broken from the inside.
A shallow pool fills the center of this chamber. A narrow ledge circles the water beneath dripping arches.
A partial cave-in blocks one side of the tunnel. The open route passes beneath cracked supports and loose stones.
A narrow door opens behind the masonry. Scratches on the floor show where someone dragged a chest across the room, and a cold draft slips through the back wall.
A cracked bell hangs above a sentry's stool. From here, narrow sightlines overlook two passages, though dust has gathered on the alarm rope.
Soot coats a broad hearth and overturned pots fill the sink. A few dry rations remain tucked into a high cupboard, beyond the reach of the rats.
Water drips at a slow, steady pace, masking quieter sounds.
A cold underground draft stirs ash and dust around your boots.
The air is thick with mildew and the sour scent of old straw.
Distant knocks echo through the stone, making it difficult to tell how far away they are.
Several old torches burn low, throwing restless shadows across the walls.
Loose rubble crunches underfoot; a wrong step could send stones rattling into the dark.
A faint metallic knock carries through the halls, then falls silent before its source can be found.
The damp air holds a trace of incense beneath the smell of old stone.

config.objective: Defeat the crypt warden to secure the silver key.

config.secret: A concealed compartment may be searched after the chest is opened.

config.trap: A pressure plate near the guard post can be noticed while exploring.

config.secret: Search the masonry for a loose stone.
